headword: {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}
reading: じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう

definitions.gloss: autonomic nervous system disorder; imbalance of the autonomic nerves
definitions.explanation: A label used widely in Japan for a cluster of symptoms — dizziness, fatigue, palpitations, sweating, insomnia — attributed to an imbalance between the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems. Commonly linked to stress, irregular hours, and seasonal change.

examples.japanese: {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: I was diagnosed with an autonomic nervous system disorder.

examples.japanese: {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}で{朝|あさ}なかなか{起|お}きられない。
examples.english: Because of dysautonomia, I have a hard time getting up in the morning.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}すので、{自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}ではないかと{心配|しんぱい}している。
examples.english: I fall ill whenever the seasons change, so I'm worried it might be an autonomic nervous system disorder.

notes:
A broad, everyday diagnostic label rather than a precisely defined disease; Japanese speakers use it conversationally for run-down periods with no clear organic cause.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}と{診断|しんだん}される: to be diagnosed with it
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}が{乱|みだ}れる: for the autonomic nerves to get out of balance
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}を{整|ととの}える: to restore autonomic balance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {更年期障害|こうねんきしょうがい}: menopausal disorder — overlapping symptoms, but tied to a specific life stage
- {過労|かろう}: overwork, exhaustion — a cause rather than a diagnosis
